messages.content: Alert rules: page SRE if p99_latency_ms >= 900 for 10 minutes, warn if error_rate > 1.5% for 5 minutes, suppress if traffic_rps < 20, and auto-scale if cpu_utilization >= 72% AND queue_depth > 500. Do not page during maintenance_window=true.
Thresholds: p99 >=900/10m, error_rate >1.5%/5m, suppress traffic <20, scale cpu >=72 and queue >500, no page during maintenance.
